FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
ENV VITE_API_URL=/api
RUN pnpm run build
WORKDIR /app/server
RUN npm ci
RUN npx prisma generate
RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const s=fs.readFileSync("prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); const categories=s.slice(s.indexOf("const DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES = "),s.indexOf("async function main()")); fs.writeFileSync("categories.mjs",categories+"\nexport default DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES;\n");'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import { prisma } from "./src/prisma.ts";' 'import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";' 'import fs from "node:fs";' 'import categories from "./categories.mjs";' 'if (!process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD || !process.env.JWT_SECRET) throw new Error("Required runtime credentials missing");' 'fs.mkdirSync("/app/.data/uploads", {recursive:true});' 'await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {' 'await tx.systemSetting.upsert({where:{id:1},update:{},create:{id:1,allowRegistration:true,emailNotifications:true,maxUploadMb:5,maintenanceMode:false,privacyNotice:"iHOPED processes personal information in line with POPIA. Data is used solely to assess housing assistance applications and will not be shared without lawful basis."}});' 'for (const cat of categories) await tx.documentCategory.upsert({where:{id:cat.id},update:{},create:{...cat,enabled:true}});' 'const owner = await tx.admin.findUnique({where:{username:"sindiswa-cell"}});' 'if (!owner) await tx.admin.create({data:{username:"sindiswa-cell",fullName:"System Administrator",email:"sindiswa-cell@localhost.invalid",passwordHash:await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD,12),active:true,mustChangePassword:false}});' '});' 'await prisma.$disconnect();' 'await import("./src/index.ts");' 'await import("./web.mjs");' > bootstrap.mjs
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import http from "node:http";' 'const app=express();' 'for (const prefix of ["/api", "/uploads"]) app.use(prefix,(req,res)=>{' 'const upstream=http.request({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:4000,path:req.originalUrl,method:req.method,headers:req.headers},r=>{res.writeHead(r.statusCode,r.headers);r.pipe(res);});' 'upstream.on("error",()=>{if(!res.headersSent)res.writeHead(502);res.end();});req.pipe(upstream);' '});' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'app.listen(8080,"0.0.0.0");' > web.mjs
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite
ENV PORT=4000
ENV HOME=/tmp
COPY --from=build /app/dist /app/dist
COPY --from=build /app/server/node_modules /app/server/node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/server/package.json /app/server/package.json
COPY --from=build /app/server/src /app/server/src
COPY --from=build /app/server/prisma/schema.prisma /app/server/prisma/schema.prisma
COPY --from=build /app/server/bootstrap.mjs /app/server/bootstrap.mjs
COPY --from=build /app/server/categories.mjs /app/server/categories.mjs
COPY --from=build /app/server/web.mjs /app/server/web.mjs
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && chown 10001:10001 /app/.data && ln -s /app/.data/uploads /app/server/uploads
USER 10001:10001
WORKDIR /app/server
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node", "--import", "tsx", "bootstrap.mjs"]
